_comment: Outlet registry for the faham daily news collector. Every entry with a non-null `feed` was actually fetched and confirmed to return RSS/Atom XML with recent items on 2026-08-02 (see bot/README.md for how to re-verify). Entries with `feed: null` have no working RSS/Atom endpoint as of that date; `listing` points a future scraper at the best available page instead. Tiers encode editorial priority, not source volume: tier 1 = primary/official documents, tier 2 = wire services and established newsroom reporting, tier 3 = everything else, including Chinese-language dailies whose headlines are marked `headline_only` and must never be treated as facts (see docs/governance.md and bot/README.md).

outlets.name: Parliament of Malaysia — Hansard (Dewan Rakyat)
outlets.note: Official Hansard archive. No RSS/Atom found; listing page returns HTTP 200 and lists sitting dates/documents. A scraper would need to diff this listing for newly posted sittings.

outlets.name: Federal Gazette (Attorney General's Chambers / Lawnet)
outlets.note: Home page itself lists the most recent P.U.(A)/P.U.(B) gazette entries with dates. No RSS/Atom found. A scraper would need to parse act-view.php links off this page.

outlets.name: Election Commission of Malaysia (SPR)
outlets.note: No RSS/Atom found. Election results, by-election notices and redelineation (persempadanan) updates are posted as static pages/PDFs; a scraper would need to be pointed at the specific results/announcement sections.

outlets.name: Bank Negara Malaysia — Press Releases
outlets.note: No RSS/Atom found. The press-releases page responded HTTP 202 (likely a JS-rendered/edge-cached page) rather than static HTML, so a future scraper may need to render JS or find BNM's underlying JSON API.

outlets.name: Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM)
outlets.note: No RSS/Atom found. Statistical releases (CPI, GDP, labour force, etc.) are listed on this page; each release is dated and would be diffable.

outlets.name: Ministry of Finance Malaysia (MOF) — Press & Citations
outlets.note: No RSS/Atom found. Covers budget announcements, subsidy/tax policy statements.

outlets.name: Inland Revenue Board of Malaysia (LHDN)
outlets.note: No RSS/Atom found. The /media-centre/media-releases path guessed during verification 404'd and a /media/ path returned 403; only the general homepage was confirmed reachable (HTTP 200). A scraper needs to locate the current media-releases URL by hand.

outlets.name: Judiciary of Malaysia (Kehakiman) — Courts
outlets.note: No RSS/Atom found. Court records and judgments would need a dedicated scraper (e.g. the e-Kehakiman/e-Review portals), not attempted here.

outlets.name: Malaysian Anti-Corruption Commission (SPRM/MACC)
outlets.note: No RSS/Atom found. A guessed media-statement path 404'd; only the homepage was confirmed reachable (HTTP 200).

outlets.name: Malaysiakini
outlets.note: Verified 2026-08-02: HTTP 200, valid RSS 2.0, 30 items, most recent pubDate same-day. The BM/Chinese/Tamil edition endpoints (/rss/melayu, /rss/chinese, /rss/tamil) return HTTP 200 with an empty 'Not Found' body — not usable, so only the English feed is registered.

outlets.name: Free Malaysia Today (FMT)
outlets.note: Verified 2026-08-02: HTTP 200, valid RSS 2.0 (WordPress), 50 items, same-day pubDates. A guessed Bahasa-section feed (/category/bahasa/feed/) 404'd, so only the main feed is registered.

outlets.name: Malay Mail
outlets.note: Verified 2026-08-02: HTTP 200, valid RSS 2.0, 50 items, same-day pubDates. Malaysia-section feed chosen over the site-wide feed for relevance.

outlets.name: The Vibes
outlets.note: Verified 2026-08-02: HTTP 200, valid RSS 2.0, 100 items, same-day pubDates.

outlets.name: CodeBlue (Galen Centre — health policy)
outlets.note: Verified 2026-08-02: HTTP 200, valid RSS 2.0 (WordPress), 10 items, dated within the prior 2 days. Health-policy specialist outlet — useful for the healthcare keyword theme.

outlets.name: Macaranga (environment/science policy)
outlets.note: Verified 2026-08-02 with a browser User-Agent: HTTP 200, valid RSS 2.0, 10 items. IMPORTANT: with the collector's own declared User-Agent (faham-collector/1.0) the same URL returns HTTP 403 — Macaranga appears to block non-browser UAs. The feed is real and kept in the registry, but expect it to show up under feeds_failed in most collect.mjs runs until this is resolved (e.g. by asking the site to allowlist the UA, or rotating a browser-like UA — not done here to keep the collector honestly identified).

outlets.name: Bernama (national news agency)
outlets.note: No working RSS found. https://rss.bernama.com/ and https://www.bernama.com/bm/rssfeed.php both resolve but do not return feed XML (landing page / HTTP 500). The /en/general/ section listing is confirmed reachable (HTTP 200) for a future scraper.

outlets.name: The Edge Malaysia
outlets.note: No working RSS found; several historical feed URLs (rss.html, feeds.theedgemarkets.com/.../mytopstories.rss) all 404 after the theedgemarkets.com -> theedgemalaysia.com consolidation. No <link rel=alternate> RSS autodiscovery on the homepage either.

outlets.name: The Star
outlets.note: The Star still publishes an /RSS index page listing dozens of category feed URLs (e.g. /rss/News/Nation), but every one of those URLs 404s in practice — the RSS system appears to be decommissioned while the index page was left up. Using the Nation section listing page instead.

outlets.name: New Straits Times (NST)
outlets.note: No working RSS found (rss.xml and several Drupal-style taxonomy-feed guesses all 404). No RSS autodiscovery link on the homepage.

outlets.name: Sin Chew Daily 星洲日报
outlets.note: 标题党：星洲日报的标题倾向煽情/夸张，不作为事实来源，仅记录标题供交叉核实。No RSS found (rss.xml, /feed, ?feed=rss2, taxonomy-term guesses all fail). Kept in the registry deliberately per project owner's guidance — headline_only so downstream code never treats its titles as claims.

outlets.name: China Press 中国报
outlets.note: 标题仅供参考，不视为事实。No working RSS found (/feed/ returns a broken redirect loop; ?feed=rss2 returns HTML, not XML).

outlets.name: Oriental Daily 东方日报
outlets.note: 标题仅供参考，不视为事实。/rss redirects to /feeds and ?feed=rss2 both return HTML, not XML — no working feed found.

outlets.name: Nanyang Siang Pau 南洋商报
outlets.note: 标题仅供参考，不视为事实。No working RSS found (/feed/ 404s, ?feed=rss2 returns HTML).

outlets.name: Guang Ming Daily 光明日报
outlets.note: 标题仅供参考，不视为事实。No RSS found; even the homepage returned HTTP 403 to automated requests during verification, so a future scraper may need extra care (rate limiting / browser rendering).

outlets.name: Kwong Wah Yit Poh 光华日报
outlets.note: 标题仅供参考，不视为事实。No working RSS found (/feed/ 404s).
